description: I'm Vernon Sloane, a retired home inspector. I spent my career walking through houses people were about to spend everything on, and finding the problems nobody wanted me to find. Now I tell you what I told them. Which foundation cracks mean walk away. Where sellers hide water damage. What a damp basement is actually telling you. The twenty-dollar drainage fix that prevents twenty thousand in damage. What new builders keep getting wrong and what to check first in a house that's already stood fifty years. No sales pitch, no agent's spin. Just the same honest read I'd give you standing in the driveway. Subscribe and don't buy a house blind.
